_comment: C0-5 body translation for coding/kilocode. No extraSections in the source body, so sections/sectionTitles are omitted. axes includes the optional name_history axis (rendered via EXTRA_AXES).
_rules: 0) Keep ** emphasis, `code`, links and table structure, block-for-block with the Chinese side.
1) Official English quotes stay verbatim; Chinese-rendered paraphrases of official wording are marked (translated) on the English side — never fabricate English originals.
2) Do not upgrade 'unverified / not stated officially' semantics; the translation changes no facts.

axes.model_access: Official stance: 500+ models at zero markup: the Kilo Gateway connects hundreds of models through one API (streaming, BYOK, usage tracking); Auto Model routes automatically across Efficient/Frontier/Free tiers; BYOK has its own official page (bring your own key and use it directly); local models via Ollama / LM Studio also have official pages. Billing has three parts: Free-tier usage is billed separately (at the provider's list price), Kilo Pass, Teams per-seat subscription, Enterprise (official pricing page; concrete prices are not collected by this site per D9).
axes.runtime: Open source (GitHub MIT, main repo Kilo-Org/kilocode): VS Code extension + JetBrains plugin + CLI + Kilo Desktop (beta). Official docs state explicitly that Kilo CLI is a fork of OpenCode (supporting the same configuration). Cloud Agents: an isolated Linux container per session (Node.js/git/gh/glab preinstalled, apt available), automatic branch creation with continuous pushing, ephemeral environments — official stance: "no local machine required" (translated).
axes.local_files: The IDE extension/CLI processes your codebase on your own machine (open source, auditable by you); Cloud Agents run inside vendor-hosted isolated containers, with the repo cloned into the container and automatic branch management. Storage and retention policies for code inside containers have not been verified item by item.
axes.background: Cloud Agents are the hosted surface: start cloud sessions from any device with automatic git management; there is also Automation (scheduled/event automation, the docs have an Automate section), Code Reviewer (AI PR review), and Slack integration (use Kilo from Slack). The official homepage claims "5M+ developers".
axes.tools: MCP has official pages (Overview + Integrations); Custom Rules (custom rule files); Custom Modes; shared custom agents (Teams surface); the kilo-marketplace extension market (fork-and-submit flow has an official page).
axes.context: Sessions & Sharing and Session History and Search have official pages; Custom Rules provide persistent project instructions. An automatic cross-session memory mechanism has not been verified in any official statement.
axes.permissions: The official settings pages form a system: Auto-Approving Actions, Sandboxing, Cost Controls and Usage Safeguards. Enterprise surface: SSO/SAML, SCIM, audit logs, data residency (EU Sovereignty official page), SLA, restricting available models/providers, Shared Private Gateway BYOK (official pricing/enterprise pages).
axes.fit:
Fits: people who want open source they can audit + 500+ models at zero markup + full BYOK/local-model support, VS Code/JetBrains/CLI/cloud multi-form, free start with pay-as-you-go.
Does not fit: people wanting strong vendor-backed governance narratives (an enterprise surface exists but the entity is an open-source community company); people looking for the "official Roo Code successor" (Roo's official shutdown notice points to ZooCode/Cline and does not mention Kilo — see pitfalls).
axes.name_history:
Domain migration: kilocode.ai → kilo.ai (308 redirect measured 2026-10-22); the product name remains Kilo Code.
Lineage with Roo Code/Cline: community consensus holds Kilo descends from a Roo Code fork, but the official docs never state this lineage (officially stated only that the CLI is an OpenCode fork) — this site records the official stance.
